en_title: MSI Raising Graphics Cards Prices Again in China, According to Leak
cn_title: 爆料称MSI再次上调中国显卡价格
opus_summary: 据微信科技爆料社区ChannelGate的消息，MSI在中国全面上调显卡价格，其中RTX 5080涨幅最大，上涨1300至8000元；RTX 5060上涨200至500元。爆料称涨价仅涉及中国，但原文认为价格上涨可能最终波及美国。

paragraphs.en: Ever since the RAM crisis kicked off in earnest in November 2025, pretty much every component in a gaming PC has grown more expensive . Now, less than a month after the RTX 5080 hit $2,000 here in the US, it's reportedly going to get even more expensive in China.
paragraphs.cn: 自2025年11月内存危机全面爆发以来，游戏PC中几乎所有组件都变得更贵了。如今，RTX 5080在美国的价格达到2,000美元还不到一个月，据报道，它在中国的价格又要上涨。

paragraphs.en: According to a post on ChannelGate , a Chinese tech insider board on WeChat, and spotted by Nvidia leaker Harukaze5719 on Twitter , MSI has increased GPU prices in China across the board, but the biggest increase is hitting the RTX 5080. Nvidia's penultimate GPU is going going up from 1,300 to 8,000 Yuan, or $194 to $1,199. However, lower-specced GPUs will have much less of a price increase, with the RTX 5060 only going up between 200 to 500 Yuan, or $30 to $75.
paragraphs.cn: 根据微信上的中国科技业内人士论坛ChannelGate的一篇帖子，MSI已在中国全面上调GPU价格，其中涨幅最大的是RTX 5080。Nvidia爆料人士Harukaze5719在X上发现了这篇帖子。Nvidia这款次旗舰GPU的价格将上涨1,300至8,000元，合194至1,199美元。不过，规格较低的GPU涨幅要小得多，RTX 5060仅上涨200至500元，合30至75美元。

paragraphs.en: When Nvidia unveiled its Blackwell lineup of graphics cards, the RTX 5080 was already expensive, starting at $999, even though it was hard to find at that price for a while. But right when prices started to normalize, the RAM crisis happened, and prices have been steadily going up since February.
paragraphs.cn: Nvidia公布Blackwell显卡系列时，RTX 5080就已经很贵了，起售价为999美元，尽管有一段时间很难以这个价格买到。但就在价格开始恢复正常时，内存危机发生了，自2月以来价格一直稳步上涨。

paragraphs.en: Even according to the leaks, these price increases are only going to hit in China, but it's likely that they'll eventually filter through to the US. At the time of writing, the RTX 5080 starts at around $2,199 on Newegg, and if these price increases came to the US, that'd go up to at least $2,400, and would likely be even higher.
paragraphs.cn: 即使按照爆料，这些涨价也只会发生在中国，但它们最终很可能会传导到美国。截至撰稿时，RTX 5080在Newegg上的起售价约为2,199美元，如果这些涨价波及美国，价格将上涨至至少2,400美元，而且很可能会更高。

paragraphs.en: These Chinese price increases are coming a couple of weeks after Nvidia removed the RTX 5080 from its own storefront, due to hardware shortages. Nvidia has told me that it's going to continue making the RTX 5080 and that it'll reappear on the Nvidia marketplace when supply has stabilized, but with these kinds of price increases, it's anyone's guess on when that'll happen.
paragraphs.cn: 中国的这些涨价发生在Nvidia因硬件短缺而将RTX 5080从自家商店下架几周之后。Nvidia告诉我，它将继续生产RTX 5080，待供应稳定后，该产品会重新出现在Nvidia商城，但面对这样的涨价，谁也说不准那会是什么时候。

paragraphs.en: It's clear that the RAM crisis is going to worsen a bit in 2027. In its latest earnings call Samsung, which makes a huge portion of the world's RAM supply, has said that it expects supply to tighten in the next year. Meanwhile, multiple RAM manufacturers have sold through their entire manufacturing capacity through the next year, leaving very little for consumers. And even though AI companies are getting a lion's share of the world's memory supply, OpenAI CEO Sam Altman said in an interview last month that it's ' quite terrible' that people have RAM in their own PCs .
paragraphs.cn: 很明显，内存危机将在2027年进一步恶化。生产全球很大一部分内存的Samsung在最近一次财报电话会议上表示，预计明年供应将趋紧。与此同时，多家内存制造商到明年为止的全部产能都已售罄，留给消费者的供应寥寥无几。尽管AI公司获得了全球内存供应的绝大部分，OpenAI首席执行官Sam Altman上个月在一次采访中表示，人们在自己的PC中拥有内存是「相当糟糕的」。
